scope: web routes and catalogue-view UI for previewed, backed-up catalogue updates and restores (ADR-0118); the direct install route is unchanged
base: origin/main 9152877c (lock commit; main unchanged at freeze)
decisions: ADR-0118: stateless token-checked apply; product-DB mutex for preview/apply/restore; backups by listed name only (regular files, exact name pattern); connection reopened after restore; backups read only when their list is opened
findings: CatalogBrowser is mounted for every session: an eager backup read would have added a request to every page load and broken ~20 strict browser fixtures; backups now load when the list is opened.
Refactoring the multipart upload into postForm hid /api/catalog/install from the companion window's mutating-fetch census; the census now counts postForm call sites and pins both update uploads.

test_first.server routes: RED 9/10 against a 501 stub (auth test already green) then 10/10
test_first.CatalogUpdatePanel: RED 12/12 against a null stub then GREEN; lazy backups RED 3 then GREEN
test_first.companion census: guard proven red by hiding one upload path

guard_mutations.caught: 16/16 (three server survivors first exposed test gaps, closed and re-run caught)

gate.browser_catalogue: 10/10 (EN/DE, Porcelain/Graphite, 1440/400: preview, back up and install, backups, ask-first restore with Escape; EN1440 stale; DE400 refused restore)

real_server_smoke.isolation: user+network namespace with only lo; HOME/XDG_*/KNX_DATA_DIR in task scratch; product DB at the isolated XDG_DATA_HOME/knx/products.sqlite
real_server_smoke.input: synthetic fictional .knxprod packages built per run
checks: first preview says New and installs nothing
first update installed with a backup
second preview names the new version and the installed one
second update kept the old program beside the new one
backups are listed newest first by name time
restore brings back exactly the catalogue before the v17 update
after a restart the restored catalogue and all backups remain
after a restart a preview compares against the restored catalogue
real_server_smoke.note: verified against the SQLite file itself; two app release-check requests to api.github.com were observed and failed inside the namespace; they are not part of the catalogue flow

visual_review: EN/DE Porcelain/Graphite 1440/400 frames and real-server frames inspected directly; Cancel made quiet and Preview again content-width after review
limitations: see KNOWN_LIMITATIONS 'Catalogue updates come only from files you supply (2026-10-12)'
